confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Florence pricing; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is volatile. USD figures assume about 1.15 USD per EUR (a planning rate, not sourced). Cocktail and wine anchors are cross-checked against the beer anchor. FX: the 14 Oct 2026 rate comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA, not a direct read of the F11.1 table; a 15 Oct value (0.6955) seen in results could not be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Rome, Venice and Bologna for restaurant and hotel levels, adjusted for Florence's high July demand; no specific listing was used.
